headline: Iron Ore Rises on Position Covering and Stock Replenishment Expectations
summary: Iron ore futures rose on the Dalian Commodity Exchange. The gains were driven by position covering and expectations of inventory replenishment.
why: Iron ore price movements directly affect the revenues and margins of major global mining conglomerates and serve as an indicator of Chinese industrial demand.

impacts.name: Iron ore
impacts.why: Trading on the Dalian Commodity Exchange showed iron ore prices increasing due to position covering and restocking demand.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Short-covering and expectations of inventory replenishment boosted buying interest among traders in major exchange contracts.
